name: Wavelet
summary: A jet-black download button whose arrow tips over into a glowing, travelling sine wave
about: Wavelet is a black pill with an electric-yellow arrow. Press it and the arrow tips over and unrolls into a live sine wave across the button; the bright part of the wave grows with the download while the rest stays dim. At the end the wave calms into a straight line, winds back into a tick and throws sparks. Lovely for music, podcast and file downloads.
how: The button squashes, the arrow tips over and a wave unrolls from it across the button while the label moves up.
The wave keeps travelling; its glowing part grows from the left as the percent counts up.
At 100% the wave settles flat, winds back into a springy tick with sparks and says Saved, then resets.
